# Dance With Dixon

> Dance With Dixon (DWD) is a dance company in Orlando, Florida, founded by choreographer and director Dixon Bowles. It runs dwdPROSERIES, competitive training for dancers ages 5 to 19 by application, and dwdCOLLECTIVE, a modern and contemporary company for adults 18 and up with no audition. Anyone can try a class first: five weekly drop-in classes, $20 to $25, booked and paid online, no audition.

All classes are at Exchange Dance, 7409 Chancery Lane, Orlando, FL 32809, on weeknights (Monday to Thursday). Contact: dancewithdixon@gmail.com. Instagram: @dwdproseries (youth) and @dwd_collective (adults). Last updated September 25, 2026; the live schedule on the website is always the source of truth for dates, prices and open spots.

## Drop-in classes (no audition, book online)

Pick a date, pay online, show up. Four or more dates in one order and each one costs less. Can't make it? Move it to another week. What to wear: all black, form-fitting (leotard and tights, or a fitted top and leggings), hair pulled back off the face. A drop-in waiver is accepted at checkout.

- [Technique & Flexibility](https://dancewithdixon.com/schedule/?class=technique-flexibility): ages 5 to 9. Tuesdays 4:45 to 5:45 pm. $20 a class, $17.50 each for 4 or more.
- [Ballet](https://dancewithdixon.com/schedule/?class=ballet): ages 10 and up, with the Elite and Pro dancers. Tuesdays 4:45 to 6:00 pm, starting October 6, 2026. $25 a class, $22.50 each for 4 or more.
- [Advanced Technique & Tricks](https://dancewithdixon.com/schedule/?class=advanced-technique-tricks): ages 12 and up, with the Pro dancers. Tuesdays 6:00 to 7:00 pm, starting October 6, 2026. $25 a class, $22.50 each for 4 or more.
- [Contemporary](https://dancewithdixon.com/schedule/?class=contemporary): ages 10 and up, with the Elite and Pro dancers. Tuesdays 7:00 to 8:30 pm, starting October 6, 2026. $25 a class, $22.50 each for 4 or more.
- [Jazz](https://dancewithdixon.com/schedule/?class=jazz): ages 10 and up, with the Elite and Pro dancers. Wednesdays 4:15 to 5:45 pm, starting October 7, 2026. $25 a class, $22.50 each for 4 or more.
- [All drop-in classes and the full weekly schedule](https://dancewithdixon.com/schedule/)

## dwdPROSERIES (competitive youth training, ages 5 to 19)

Three tracks, by application rather than a one-day audition: express interest online, take a free placement class with the company, and Dixon calls with a track offer. Placement is rolling all season; chairs are limited to ten per track. Season One runs August 10, 2026 to May 25, 2027. Training covers jazz technique, ballet, contemporary, lyrical, hip hop, tap, acro and musical theatre, with jazz and ballet technique as the foundation.

- [Prep track](https://dancewithdixon.com/proseries/): ages 5 to 9, about four hours a week, one to two competitions a season. $195 a month tuition.
- [Elite track](https://dancewithdixon.com/proseries/): ages 8 to 12, eight or more hours a week, four to six competitions plus conventions. $310 a month tuition.
- [Pro track](https://dancewithdixon.com/proseries/): ages 12 and up, ten or more hours a week, four to six competitions plus conventions, a weekly Solo Hour. $360 a month tuition.
- Costs beyond tuition: a $25 monthly admin fee, and costume and competition deposits of $25 a month each per routine. Deposits pay down the real costume and competition totals; final balances are billed on top once costumes are ordered and the competition slate locks. There is a one-time $50 registration each season. Across the ten billing months, plan on about $3,000 for Prep, $4,650 for Elite and $5,400 for Pro.
- [Express interest (apply)](https://dancewithdixon.com/proseries/#interest): a short form, about two minutes. Dixon replies personally to set up a placement class.

## dwdCOLLECTIVE (adults 18 and up)

- [The Collective](https://dancewithdixon.com/collective/): modern and contemporary dance for adults, all levels, no audition and no experience required. Class work, original choreography, and stage time when a performance project is on. $15 a class, paid at class (cash or Venmo), no contract. The next class date is posted on the Collective page and on Instagram @dwd_collective.
- [Join the Collective](https://dancewithdixon.com/contact/?reason=adult): send a message to get on the list for the next class.

## About

- [Teachers](https://dancewithdixon.com/teachers/): Dixon Bowles designs and runs the core training. He has taught dance since he was 16, danced at Weber State and Utah Valley University, toured with Disney Junior Live, taught jazz as an adjunct professor at Utah Valley University, directed Dynamic Dance Studio in Poinciana, and spent nine years at Celebration Arts Academy (five as competition director) choreographing more than 100 competition pieces. Rotation faculty: Madi Sprague (tap), Jackson Haughton (hip hop), Yahia Icheboudene (acro). Company assistants: Tori Ugalde (strength and stretch), John Nuzzi (rehearsal assistant).
- [Contact](https://dancewithdixon.com/contact/): questions, choreography bookings, workshops, guest teaching and competition judging.
- [Gallery](https://dancewithdixon.com/gallery/)
